limitations: Single seed 20262020 and four epochs per arm; no across-seed uncertainty or convergence claim.
Industrial and RF100 are previously viewed external development populations; anchor feedback48 was chosen after viewing external results. New-epoch best is selected only by source1506.
RF100 retains offline four-point-derived normalized scalar targets. All declared rows and failures remain in their denominators.

Checkpoint tensor equality and BN buffer stationarity are supported by saved initialization/runtime records and inspected implementation; this CPU audit neither loads checkpoints nor reproduces model outputs.
Training/validation CNN and backward exposure are inferred from recorded counts and inspected one-forward implementation. External CNN forward counts are instrumented saved records.
The original zero/nonzero cohorts are unchanged. Additional positive-near-zero (0<target<=0.05) and near-full-scale (0.95<=target<=1) cohorts are descriptive and do not select checkpoints.
ROI interventions change the NumPy worker random stream. Corresponding v9 controls match recipe and exposure, but photometric realizations are not stepwise identical.
